content: The serialization is based on the Ecu configuration of the COM module and • the Software Components PortPrototype , • the dataElement list defined by the respective SenderReceiverInterface , • the SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping , • and the ISignalToIPduMapping for the SystemSignalGroup .
